candidates.reason: Shared download-handler contract for TLS hostname handling and DNS failures; Twisted builds host bytes for these scenarios through the IDNA helpers the pull request replaces, so new IDNA-2003-only cases belong here.
Drives the Twisted HTTP/1.1 download handler, which resolves hostnames through HostnameEndpoint and ClientTLSOptions, both of which call the patched IDNA conversion helpers.
The HTTP/2 handler reuses the same Twisted endpoint, resolver, and TLS hostname verification path, so it exercises the same patched IDNA behavior as HTTP/1.1.
Covers the Scrapy TLS context factory, including creatorForNetloc() and the _hostnameBytes value derived from Twisted's IDNA helpers, where IDNA-2003-only host bytes are produced and verified.
Resolver tests go through Twisted resolveHostName/getHostByName, the lookup layer that receives the host bytes produced by the patched IDNA helpers.
Covers download-handler loading and the mapping of Twisted DNS/connection exceptions to Scrapy errors, the observable failure mode when an IDNA host name is rejected by Twisted.
Request construction normalizes and stores URLs, so it is the place to assert that non-ASCII host names remain intact or are Punycode-encoded before they reach Twisted.
URL host parsing and domain matching helpers are the Scrapy-side boundary for domain names, so regressions around IDNA-normalized hosts surface here.
